promptEs: Escuchá el acorde y elegí su calidad.
promptEn: Listen to the chord and choose its quality.
explanationEs: Si-Re es tercera menor y Si-Fa quinta disminuida: es un Si disminuido. La quinta disminuida es la que lo vuelve inestable y lo separa de Si menor, que tendría Fa♯.
explanationEn: B-D is a minor third and B-F a diminished fifth: it is a B diminished triad. The diminished fifth makes it unstable and separates it from B minor, which would have F♯.
